query:
SELECT
            i.id              AS "instrument_id!",
            i.isin            AS "isin!",
            i.subject_to_cgt  AS "subject_to_cgt!",
            li.currency_code  AS "currency_code!"
        FROM listing li
        JOIN instrument i ON i.id = li.instrument_id
        WHERE li.id = ?1 AND li.delisted_at IS NULL
